name: The air battle photographed: flares (B13 check)
description: The air battle check's second scenario (roadmap B13, -SimAirShots): one NATO flight at a time comes in low over a cold Osa, where a Strela-2 team shoots at it on the pass; its pilots, seeing the launch, fire flares by their reactions. The check plays it after air_battle_shots.json, whose own battle gives no IR SAM's launch.
notes: Placeholder numbers for a picture, not a battle. The waves are data/gameplay/air_battle_shots_waves.json; the seed chosen so that an early flight is one that carries flares in 1985 (gameplay/reactions.json and air_war/countermeasures.json), so the flares come in the first minutes. The Strela-2 team's figures are the theatre's (test_waves.hpp WavePassKillChance). The Osa is cold: it does not fire.
